questions: In the *denaturation/Denaturation:This is the first step of each PCR cycle — think about what happens to hydrogen bonds at high temperature.* step of PCR, double-stranded DNA is separated by heating to 94–95 °C.

The thermostable enzyme *Taq polymerase/Taq Polymerase/taq polymerase:This enzyme was originally isolated from the thermophilic bacterium Thermus aquaticus.* synthesises new DNA from each primer during the extension step at 72 °C.
